snippet.title: Kittengumi - Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Cats are an inexhaustible source of narrative resources. Any little cat can make your day even stormier. But if we're also talking about samurai cats, then I'm sure I've earned your interest. Kittengumi: The Sakabato's Thief is a visual novel developed by Guarida Games Studio, and entirely hand-drawn, where cats become the protagonists of a classic Japanese narrative. Available now on PS4,PS5, Nintendo Switch and Steam.
